The '''Abandoned Rebel Base''' was a base constructed and then abandoned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], at the end of [[Wampa Valley]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The giant [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] [[Unkajo/Legends|Unkajo]] lived near it.
